    time_to_cook: int
    num_ingredients: int

class PumpkinPie(Pie): filling: Literal['pumpkin']='pumpkin'
def get_discriminator_value(v: Any) -> str:

    return getattr(v, 'fruit', getattr(v, 'filling', None))

app=FastAPI()
@app.post('/dessert')
async def dinner(dessert: Dessert) -> dict[str, Any]: return dessert.model_dump()
dep=get_dependant(path='/dessert', call=dinner)
